title: Wong sing Disebut Ing Kulawargane Kanjeng Nabi
intro: Ing kulawargané utusan pungkasan, ana sawijining jiwa sing critané pribadiné dadi piwulang suci kanggo kabèh wong sing percaya. Uripé tokoh iki ana gandhèngané karo prentah transformatif sing mbentuk manèh adat istiadat sosial salawas-lawase, nandhani owah-owahan sing jero babagan kepriyé iman bakal nemtokaké kulawarga lan rasa kagungan.
clues: Jenengku biyèn ana gandhèngané karo garis keturunan sing mulya, nanging bebener sing luwih dhuwur mengko bakal njlentrehake ikatan iman sing sejati.
Aku iki nampa sih-rahmat kang gedhe saka Allah lan utusane, sawijining sih-rahmat kang wis kasebut kanthi cetha ing sajroning Kitab Suci.
Urip bebrayanku dadi ujian penting sing bakal ngowahi persepsi babagan hubungan sing diadopsi selawase.
Aku iki wong sing pacoban pribadine nuntun marang prentahe Gusti Allah sing ngidini Kanjeng Nabi nikah karo wong wadon sawise aku lunga.
Liwat critaku, bédané kulawarga biologis lan kulawarga pilihan dadi cetha kanggo kabèh generasi.
Aku iki siji-sijine ing antarane kanca-kancaku sing jenenge katon kanthi jelas ing wahyu pungkasan, dudu minangka nabi, nanging minangka abdi sing diuji lan dihormati.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
